source.title: extra-eyes hook fetch renderer cargo test pass

acquisition.details: Ran `cargo test` after adding `eyes message send`, `eyes hook fetch`, and hook message rendering. Result: 15 unit tests passed and 13 integration tests passed. New coverage includes watcher-origin markup, watcher/severity labels, attribute escaping, CLI enqueue, hook fetch rendering, cursor commit after stdout, and same-session deduplication by a second hook fetch returning empty output.
